prompt: Invoke the ui5-knowledge-base skill before doing any work. Then scaffold and implement a new ui5-gantt-chart component in packages/main. The component must support: draggable task bars on a virtualized timeline, dependency arrows between tasks, critical-path highlighting, zoom levels (day/week/month/quarter) as a public property, and resource swimlanes as slotted children. Create all required files: GanttChart.ts, GanttChartTemplate.tsx, themes/GanttChart.css, and src/types/ enums for zoom level. Follow all project conventions strictly.
